card.name: Spots just before an ellipsis
card.fires_on: Scattered tokens in informal or broken text where an ellipsis (...) is likely to come next, such as the end of a clause, a dash line, or a unit like km/h. It is not tied to one word.

modes.label: Dash lines and separators
modes.description: Long runs of dashes or a lone hyphen or colon that sit in a formula or list.
modes.example: CLcr= [140-age (years)] x weight (kg) (x 0.85 for female patients) —————————<<————>>— 72 x serum creatinine

modes.label: Sentence ends in casual prose
modes.description: A period or colon ending a clause in chatty or quoted web text, where trailing dots may follow.
modes.example: is not concerned with the detail of stationary parts of the world around him<<.>> He will starve to death surrounded by

modes.label: Mid-word in forum posts
modes.description: Partway through a word or after a conjunction in sloppy forum text that uses dots.
modes.example: im developing a GIS using flash and action<<script>>..can : you please send me

card.writes: It lowers the chance of the ellipsis forms with spaces before them and raises the chance of the same marks with no space, which shifts how an ellipsis is written.
card.plain: It fires at points in casual, messy text where trailing dots (...) might come next.
